description: This file defines the LexRuntimeV2Client class used to interact with the Amazon Lex Runtime V2 service via the AWS SDK for PHP. It primarily provides method signatures for interactions like session management and text recognition with asynchronous and synchronous options.

classes.name: LexRuntimeV2Client
classes.description: A client class for interacting with Amazon Lex Runtime V2, extending the generic AwsClient.

methods.name: deleteSession
methods.description: Deletes a session in Amazon Lex Runtime V2.

methods.name: deleteSessionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a session in Amazon Lex Runtime V2.

methods.name: getSession
methods.description: Retrieves session information from Amazon Lex Runtime V2.

methods.name: getSessionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves session information from Amazon Lex Runtime V2.

methods.name: putSession
methods.description: Creates or updates a session in Amazon Lex Runtime V2.

methods.name: putSessionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates or updates a session.

methods.name: recognizeText
methods.description: Recognizes text via Amazon Lex Runtime V2.
